parse.title: List of Areas (Pet Simulator 99)
parse.wikitext:
'''Areas''', also known as '''Biomes''', are differently themed regions within each world in [[Pet Simulator 99]]. Unlocking certain areas grants access to new [[List of Eggs (Pet Simulator 99)|eggs]], resources, [[Upgrades (Pet Simulator 99)|upgrades]], [[Minigames (Pet Simulator 99)|minigames]], [[List of Machines (Pet Simulator 99)|machines]], and [[List of Boss Chests (Pet Simulator 99)|boss chests]].

The [[Fishing World (Pet Simulator 99)|Fishing World]] and the [[Farming World (Pet Simulator 99)|Farming World]] are special worlds that can be accessed at any time from areas #26 and #54 in World 1, as well as from the hub of any other world.

There are currently '''274 unlockable areas''' across '''4 worlds''' and '''8 sub-worlds'''.
